Collect, prepare, and clean large datasets for analysis, identifying and resolving data anomalies, inconsistencies, and quality issues to ensure analytical integrity

Bachelor's degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related discipline
Demonstrated experience in a data science or advanced analytics role, with a portfolio of applied projects
Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R, with experience in data manipulation libraries (e.g. pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
Strong understanding of statistical modelling, machine learning algorithms, and data mining techniques
Experience working with large datasets and familiarity with SQL and database querying
Ability to develop and evaluate predictive models, performing validation, tuning, and performance assessment
Proficiency in data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent libraries (e.g. Matplotlib, Seaborn)
Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex findings into clear, business-relevant insights
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with experience presenting to non-technical audiences
Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and contribute effectively within a collaborative team environment
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative or data-related field
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, particularly for model deployment and data storage
Familiarity with MLOps practices and tools for model versioning, monitoring, and deployment pipelines
Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, or other specialist machine learning domains
Experience working within Agile or Scrum delivery frameworks
Relevant industry certifications in data science, machine learning, or cloud computing (e.g. AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer)
Prior experience in a relevant industry sector such as finance, healthcare, retail, or government
Why Join Us?
Be part of a forward-thinking team that places data and innovation at the core of strategic decision-making, giving you meaningful impact from day one
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for further study, certifications, and attendance at industry conferences
Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements that support a healthy work-life balance
Competitive remuneration package with superannuation and opportunities for performance-based progression
Collaborative and inclusive workplace culture that values diverse perspectives and encourages knowledge sharing
